name: Sentinel
description: Detailed, encrypted diary of what Nuxiva sees, hears and does at home. Only the owner can read it and every read is recorded.
capabilities: Arrivals and departures of household members and of the day's guests
Refused requests, display privacy shutter and automations started
Colour of the clothing worn, only when recognised with confidence and without storing images
Per-day encryption with cryptographic erasure on expiry, hash chain and hourly signature
Encrypted memory of who and what passes the cameras: clothing, carried items, vehicles, deliveries, covered faces

settings.NUXIVA_SENTINEL_APPEARANCE: Note the colour of the clothing worn (codes only, no images)
settings.NUXIVA_SENTINEL_GUESTS: Note guest arrivals and departures (details kept for 24 hours)
settings.NUXIVA_SENTINEL_MEMORY: Remember what the cameras see passing by (look, vehicles, deliveries), encrypted
settings.NUXIVA_SENTINEL_WATCH_EVERY: How often, in seconds, Sentinel looks at the cameras

narrative.sentinel.self.chat_request: Chat {channel} · journey {journey} · intent {intent} · planned {planned} · executor {executor} · status {status}
narrative.sentinel.access.denied: {who} asked for {action}: I did not do it
narrative.sentinel.display.privacy_shutter: I hid personal data from the display: {reason}
narrative.sentinel.display.privacy_open: I opened the display again for {person}
narrative.sentinel.sentinel.read: The diary was read from the admin page
narrative.sentinel.word.uncertain: I can't recognise who is here
